rationale: PP03 is a within-row position-purity issue. The raw filing separates the current March 31, 2023 portfolio schedule from the December 31, 2022 comparative schedule: tables 15-24 carry March rows and tables 62-71 carry December rows, with footnote text stating December 31, 2022 rates for the comparative schedule. The six flagged holdings correspond to December schedule rows and should not be retained as 2023-03-31 source-period facts; matching March rows exist with current-period rates for the same instruments.
